resources.string: Import Rime vocabulary, choose a base and supplementary tables
Unlock the device to manage vocabulary
Choose a base vocabulary; supplementary tables are optional.
Remove imported table “%s”? The original source file is unchanged.
Processing offline… Applying a vocabulary pauses keyboard input until deployment finishes.
Ready. Changes take effect after Apply. Personal learning and layouts are preserved.

Source file: %1$s

Source and license notices remain in the original dictionary file. Importing vocabulary does not install its upstream scheme.

The bundled engine uses pinned Wanxiang Base v18.1.13 and its offline Simplified Chinese grammar model. The model alone is about 388 MiB; dictionaries and compiled data need additional storage. First deployment compiles the offline data; wait for candidates.

Existing .dict.yaml imports and their originals remain supported. Add supplements to bundled Base, or explicitly choose an imported base using the existing data-only schema. Import dependencies too; directory references resolve by their final dictionary name. Archives must be unzipped first.

Imports require UTF-8 text with explicit lowercase untoned Pinyin codes separated by Tab. Supports text/code/weight columns and import_tables; missing weight defaults to 1. Use spaces between syllables and v for ü. No preset essay frequency, percentage weights, nonempty stem, tone numbers, auxiliary rules, arbitrary scripts, models or schema/custom.yaml patches through this importer.

Up to 64 tables, 64 MiB each and 256 MiB total. Apply compiles separately and retains a working choice on failure. Layout preferences, original imports and old learning files are retained. Wanxiang uses its own learning database; old Pinyin learning/rankings are not automatically converted. Restore bundled resets only the table selection. The 0.3.0 fallback uses its earlier data-only schema.
